how-it-works.title: Discovery & Strategy
how-it-works.description: We spend the first week deep-diving into your business model, user personas, and technical landscape. You leave with a detailed product spec, AI opportunity map, and project roadmap.

how-it-works.title: Design & Prototyping
how-it-works.description: Our designers produce high-fidelity Figma prototypes and interactive demos in under two weeks. You validate the experience before a single line of production code is written.

how-it-works.title: Agile Development
how-it-works.description: Engineering squads work in two-week sprints with daily standups, live staging environments, and weekly demos. You always know exactly where your product stands.

how-it-works.title: Launch & Scale
how-it-works.description: We handle deployment, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and post-launch optimization. Once live, our growth team identifies the next AI-powered feature to keep you ahead.
